courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 沉箱式防波堤施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「主動土壓假設」與「護舷曲線積分」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；沉箱式防波堤施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Active earth-pressure assumptions" and "Integrating fender response" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Caisson breakwater construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑；沉箱式防波堤施工則以沿製造浮運到基床受力追蹤沉箱防波堤的狀態變化為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation; Caisson breakwater construction centres on track caisson-breakwater state changes from fabrication and flotation to foundation loading, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「主動土壓假設」與「混凝土量與重量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到沉箱式防波堤施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「滑動平衡的界限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Active earth-pressure assumptions” and “Concrete volume and weight”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Caisson breakwater construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Limits of sliding equilibrium", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 棧橋式碼頭樁基
related.transfer: 可遷移「主動土壓假設」與「護舷曲線積分」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；棧橋式碼頭樁基的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Active earth-pressure assumptions" and "Integrating fender response" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Pile-supported pier foundations must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑；棧橋式碼頭樁基則以由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation; Pile-supported pier foundations centres on trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「主動土壓假設」與「鋼管截面與軸應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到棧橋式碼頭樁基，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「沖刷與側向剛度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Active earth-pressure assumptions” and “Steel-pipe section and axial stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Pile-supported pier foundations, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Scour and lateral stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型港口沉箱碼頭
history.text: 沉箱碼頭與沉箱防波堤共享大型製造及基床接觸問題，但背填、船舶和岸上設備形成不同受力路徑。新加坡主管機關列大士港第一期首座沉箱在二〇一六年安裝，二〇一九年完成最後一座，二〇二一年宣布第一期填海完成；這些里程碑不等於全港所有期別同時營運。香港手冊提供一般海事與岸壁背景，仍須核對適用勘誤。釜石只作海事沉箱功能比較，不能將防波堤海嘯受力移作碼頭背填模型。課程刻意分開土壓、水壓、護舷及地基作用，全部數值都是原創合成假設。
history.textEn: Caisson quays and breakwaters share fabrication and bedding questions but have different load paths from backfill, vessels and terminal equipment. Singapore records the first Phase1 Tuas caisson in2016, the last in2019 and completion of Phase1 reclamation in2021; these milestones do not imply simultaneous operation of every port phase. Hong Kong guidance supplies maritime and waterfront context subject to applicable corrigenda. Kamaishi serves only as a functional comparison of marine caissons, not a source for replacing quay backfill with tsunami loading. The course separates earth, water, fender and foundation actions using entirely synthetic numerical assumptions.
